_p316_cascade_disarmed_note: [P316 2026-08-18] P311 ARMED this and P316 DISARMED it the same day, on better data. P311 calibrated the threshold from 11 days of the derivflow ledger (85 observations/asset) and estimated a 1-2% firing rate. Six months of per-4H-bar liquidation history (1,039 bars x 3 assets) says the same multiple fires on 11-14% of bars - a ~6x error - and a replay of the DETECT against forward returns shows a 5x spike carries NO information (|t| <= 0.93 on all three). At 20x the rate is 1-2% and there is a weak BTC-only hint (-1.09%/24h, t=-2.31, n=21) that does not survive being one of 12 cells. The multiple is now 20 so any future arming starts calibrated, but the flag is OFF: an exceptional firing rate is a PRECONDITION, not evidence that a DETECT helps. The structural fix stands - the threshold is expressed in each asset own units instead of one dollar figure that was routine on BTC and unreachable on SOL.
_p306_real_1h_note: [P306 2026-08-18] The 1h price move fed to the cascade governor was price_change_4h_pct / 4.0 - a fixed rescale, not a measurement. Two consequences it caused, both on a live risk path: DETECT needs <= -3% in 1h, which under a /4 rescale needs a 12% 4H move (unreachable); and exhaustion is forced to >=0.5 whenever |1h| < 1%, which |4h/4| almost always is, so the governor claimed price was STABILIZING throughout any real cascade. Now the last COMPLETED Kraken hourly candle (public, keyless, same endpoint the regimebook harness already reads at interval=240). Enabled because it is a measurement replacing a fabrication with no free parameter, and both effects are protective. The measured value is logged and published as price_change_1h_pct_real regardless of this flag, so the comparison stays observable. REVERT: delete the key (falls back to the rescale; a Kraken outage already does so per-tick).
_p306_dvol_note: [P306 2026-08-18] Enabled ONLY because what is now published is a Z-SCORE. constitution.py aliases dvol -> dvol_zscore and fires EXTREME_DVOL at >= 5.0, and Deribit publishes an index LEVEL (BTC ~34) - P298 correctly refused to flip this flag because publishing the level would have read as z=34 and permanently flattened the book (EXTREME_DVOL is not in the sleeve HOLD set). The denominator is FETCHED, not accrued: Deribit serves an arbitrary range, so the trailing year exists from the first tick. Live at enablement: BTC level 34.13 -> z -1.38, ETH 45.69 -> z -1.96 (both at the BOTTOM of their own trailing year), far from the 5.0 trigger and outside the 2.5-4.0 vol-expansion band. SOL gets no key - Deribit lists zero SOL options, and an absence stays an absence. REVERT: delete the key.

Grouped deliberately: every item here is either (a) real data replacing a fabricated constant on a channel that cannot reach an order, or (b) a TIGHTENING that can only reduce exposure, or (c) certified by measurement. Four items were NOT flipped because measurement contradicts them (mlpshadow - the model was withdrawn by its own seed probe P285c; v5_1_strategies_live - 6/9 measured KILL with n_directional=0; trend_regime_gate enforce - forward evidence INVERTED, blocked ticks made +9.2bps vs kept -2.5; dynamic_alpha_gate_enforce - P287 measured it would flatten the standing BTC long). One item (dvol_to_market_data) could not be flipped at all until a units bug was fixed - see the P298 entry: Deribit publishes DVOL as an INDEX LEVEL (BTC 34.5) and the constitution aliases dvol->dvol_zscore then fires EXTREME_DVOL at >=5.0, which is NOT in the sleeve HOLD set, so enabling it would have permanently flattened the book. REVERT ANY: delete the key.

_sentiment_zscore_mode_note: [P298, on P296 evidence] The live 'z-score' is a fixed linear rescale (fg-50)/50*3 because the feed asked for limit=1; the real distribution is free from the same endpoint (3,117 days back to 2018-02-01, now fetched and persisted). P296 backtested all three readings over 6 years in the DERIVATIVES expression: historical matches linear's Sharpe (0.91 vs 0.92) on 33% LESS exposure, and therefore pays less than HALF the funding carry (-23.9% vs -49.5% over 6y). In a perp book that is the whole argument - cutting exposure stops a bleed rather than merely forgoing return. Neither reading beat buy-and-hold, so this is chosen for its carry profile, not for edge.
_whale_filter_enforce_note: [P298] whale disagreement blocks ENTRY-FROM-FLAT on the sleeve driver. Strictly tightening: a silent whale fails OPEN (a dead agent must never become a standing veto, P208), exits are never filtered, an aligned held position is never force-exited, and a disagreeing flip is demoted to flat rather than reversed. Whale is the best-evidenced of the zero-weighted agents (positive IC in every measured window) but does NOT clear the P166 bar (60d 16h t=0.26) - which is exactly why it is expressed as a VETO rather than a driver: a filter is the defensible form of a weak-but-positive signal. Worst case if wrong: fewer entries.

_fusion_conviction_note: [P298] Carries fusion's conviction ratio (final base_exposure / pre-modulation baseline) into the sleeve's contract sizing. This is the ONLY channel by which the 22 non-DECIDE agents can reach an order at all - their entire output is exposure modulation, which is discarded twice downstream (the tranche overwrite at integration_v36.py:1678, then sign-based sizing). Strictly de-risking: it can only REDUCE magnitude, never increase it, and never changes a sign. An unusable ratio leaves size UNCHANGED, never 0 (a fabricated 0 would read as 'every advisor said flat'). Expect somewhat less time in market; at 1-3 contracts it often rounds to the same integer.
_regimebook_mode_note: [P298, on P297 evidence] The regime book takes the DECIDE slot. This is the best-evidenced change in the batch: P297 measured the BTC book over 6 years of funding history in the derivatives expression - book +243.9% vs trend-only +151.7% vs buy-and-hold +184.5%, the funding-leg increment positive in ALL THREE eras (pre-design +16.9, design +43.7, validation +29.0), beating a same-cell random control by ~286 points, and the book's Sharpe CI is the ONLY one in that comparison excluding zero. The flag is GLOBAL, and that is fine: book_target gives BTC the full book, ETH trend-only and SOL hold-bull-only, which is exactly the P247/P250 measured roster. SEAT PRECEDENCE: the whale seat runs after this one and would otherwise override it, so P298 made whale DEFER to a directional book target - whale now seats only where the book is FLAT. That preserves the P293j intent (whale trades where the incumbent could not) without letting a t=0.26 signal outrank a three-era certification.

_coinbase_venue_aware_spreads_note: ENABLED 2026-08-16 (P289) by explicit operator instruction ('the one lever that's a measurement'). The alpha gate's per-leg slippage constants ({BTC:3, ETH:5, SOL:10}) were Kraken-era spread assumptions applied to CDE nano contracts. Live read-only order-book probe 2026-08-16 (WEEKEND book = worst case, 6 samples/contract): median FULL spreads BTC 1.58 / ETH 5.26 / SOL 2.65 bps. CDE table charges the full spread rounded conservatively ({BTC:2.0, ETH:5.5, SOL:4.0} — true taker cost is the HALF-spread, so ~2x buffer, P167; note ETH ROSE 5.0->5.5, honest in both directions). Consequence: BTC threshold ~29 -> ~26bps (the 1-2bp ALLOW_EPSILON pass becomes robust); SOL ~55 -> ~40 and ETH ~43 — BOTH STILL ABOVE the 30bps asserted-alpha ceiling, so this does NOT re-open ETH/SOL (pinned by tests/test_p289_venue_spreads.py); only the P237 tripwire question can. Wrong-way failures keep the Kraken table (overcharge, safe). REVERT: set false and redeploy.
_coinbase_maker_reprice_note: ENABLED 2026-08-17 (P291). Both live maker attempts so far posted at the touch, sat the full 45s unfilled, and crossed as taker. The ladder reprices ONCE at the half-way mark, and only when the touch has actually moved past our resting order (no move = no reprice = no churn). It rides INSIDE the existing coinbase_maker_wait_sec budget — never extends it, because a longer wait means a staler signal (P265 dead-signal-fill class). Enabled rather than shipped default-off because it cannot change WHAT trades (only how the passive leg is placed) and its worst case is byte-identical to today: cancel and cross at timeout. Invariants pinned by tests/test_p291_maker_ladder.py: never more than one live post-only at a time; a FAILED cancel refuses both the re-post and the cross; never re-post beside an unknown or partial fill (the venue reconcile sizes the remainder); urgent=True still bypasses the ladder entirely. _coinbase_venue_true_hold_note: [SUPERSEDED BY THE ARMED NOTE ABOVE — kept for the arithmetic] Built 2026-08-17 (P291), initially NOT armed. The finding is real and verified: the alpha gate charges routed assets Kraken's spot-margin BORROW schedule (MARGIN_FEE_BPS opening + per-4h rollover x 6 hold periods = the live 'margin=7' BTC / '14.0bps hold' ETH+SOL), which fires on ~93% of ticks because regime_leverage is 2.0 for the two dominant regimes. CDE posts margin as COLLATERAL (P275 probe: INTRADAY_MARGIN_SETTING_STANDARD), not a borrow — the venue never levies that fee, and because update_funding_rate takes max(rollover, funding), the Kraken rollover has been masking P277's venue-aware funding on the hold path since it shipped (structurally inert, pinned by test). Venue-true thresholds: BTC 26.4->19.1, ETH 44.0->26.7, SOL 40.3->29.0. WHY IT IS OFF: unlike the P289 spread fix (which explicitly did NOT re-open ETH/SOL), this one crosses BOTH below the 30bps asserted-alpha ceiling — i.e. it OPENS ETH and SOL to live trading at full conviction. That is a P141 activation decision, on a signal whose measured alpha slope is ~0, fifteen days before the 09-01 tripwire that may remove the trend seat entirely. SOL clears by only ~1bps and re-closes at funding 0.000400 (pinned) — 'SOL opens' is conditional, not structural. ARM: set true + redeploy, with its own recorded P-entry. The gate is INDEPENDENT of coinbase_venue_aware_spreads by design.
_coinbase_protective_stop_note: [SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23, P382] Widened to ALL routed assets the same day (P205: empty assets list = all; verified live); the SOL-only rollout below is history. Distance is measured from the position's avg entry price (a fixed-risk stop, not trailing). SOL-first is the P141 rollout: watch a full [COINBASE-STOP] PLACED -> OK_EXISTS -> FLAT_CANCELLED cycle before widening. WIDEN: empty the assets list to cover BTC/ETH. CAVEAT: CDE rejects reduce_only, so the stop is a plain order; it is reconciled every tick and cancelled the moment the asset is flat, because an orphan stop would OPEN an opposite position.
_p380_velocity_note: [P380] ARMED 2026-08-22 by operator instruction ("I want all elements active", risk appetite "can afford to lose"). This does NOT un-retire the P370 drift trigger: with fast_risk_velocity_trigger=true the emergency exit acts on INTER-TICK velocity (the move since the previous ~30s evaluation), not on cumulative drift from the resetting 4H anchor. P370 retired drift because it fired on 19% of evaluations (value-destroying, 33 flattens of profitable longs in 2 days). Velocity is the P367 replacement: live shadow over 257 evaluations fired 0.0%% on all 3 assets — it triggers ONLY on a genuine >3%% 30s dislocation (a flash crash), which is exactly what an emergency exit is for. Before this the sleeve had NO price-based emergency exit at all (drift retired, velocity off); the vol-spike REDUCE_50 @4x and the 10%% venue-resting stop were the only price protections. WORST CASE if wrong: one flatten+re-entry on a >3%% inter-tick move that reverses (rare). REVERT: set fast_risk_price_move_threshold 0.0 and remove fast_risk_velocity_trigger.
_p370_risk_control_note: [P370] ARMED 2026-08-22 by explicit operator instruction on the P369 six-year backtest (training/risk_control_audit_lab.py, three assets, three eras, criteria pre-committed). (1) fast_risk_price_move_threshold=0.0 RETIRES the 3% price-move EXIT_ONLY: it cost 10-93%/yr of notional, bought no tail protection, was era-unstable on BTC/SOL, fired at the 94th-99th percentile of routine drift, and measured drift from a RESETTING 4H anchor with no reference to the position (live: 33 flattens of profitable longs in ~2 days, ~$195 of churn vs -$118.64 PnL). The 10% venue-resting stop (coinbase_protective_stop_pct) is the real protection and stays. (2) fast_risk_vol_spike_mult=4.0 loosens the vol-spike REDUCE_50 from 2x (166-194 fires/yr, 29-40%/yr tax, ~zero tail effect) to 4x (one-fifth the cost); set 0 to retire it too. (3) coinbase_max_sleeve_drawdown_pct=0.25: at 15% the halt trips SOL 48-77x in six years and removes 60-85% of its return; at 25% it is a real, cheap insurance premium on all three (BTC +4pp, ETH -18..-51pp, SOL -87..-110pp over 6y) and matches the existing risk.hard_drawdown_halt. REVERT: delete the first two keys (class constants 3%/2x return) and set the third to 0.15.

_p295_trend_floor_note: [P295 2026-08-18, operator-instructed] Trend's signal is a mean of signs over 3 lookbacks, so |signal| is quantized to {1/3, 1} — nothing between. Through 40 x |sig| x 0.75 that is 10bps or 30bps, against live thresholds of 19.1/26.7/29.0, so a 2-of-3 majority is UNTRADEABLE by construction and the gate vetoed it every tick (this is what produced dir=+0.00 with Alpha 10bps). The old floor of 0.30 sat BELOW the smallest reachable |signal| (1/3=0.3333) and so could never fire — a control that could not act. 0.50 sits strictly between the two reachable values: the 2-of-3 vote now reads FLAT instead of asserting an opinion the gate must veto. DELIBERATELY NOT the other fix: raising base_edge_bps so 2-of-3 clears the bar would be manufacturing tradeability on a signal whose realized slope was measured at -0.74..+3.01 with every |t| < 0.8 (P293k) — the P231 error. Same resulting book, honest logs, and a clean hand-off to the whale seat, which does clear the gate. REVERT: set 0.30.
_p293j_whale_seat_note: [P293j 2026-08-17, operator-instructed 'let the whale turn on'] whale takes the DECIDE slot when it HAS an opinion; the incumbent (trend) keeps the seat when whale is silent. WHY: the system was not trading — every tick logged dir=+0.00 with 'Alpha 10bps' against thresholds of 19-60bps, because trend emits |dir|~0.33 -> 40 x 0.33 x 0.75 = 10bps, below every threshold. whale emits +/-1.0 BINARY -> 30bps whenever it speaks, which clears BTC 19.1 / ETH 26.7 / SOL 29.0 (the P291b venue-true thresholds). Measured firing rate over 60d of attribution: BTC 54%% / ETH 43%% / SOL 12%% of ticks; whale speaks when trend cannot on 30%% / 25%% / 11%%. HONEST CAVEAT: whale clears the gate because it is BINARY, not because it is better evidenced — its live IC is +0.040 (4h) / +0.011 (16h), statistically indistinguishable from zero, though still better than the incumbent quant's NEGATIVE -0.046 at 16h. This deliberately trades 'no trades at all' for 'trades on a weak but positive signal', with flip-persistence (2 ticks), the alpha gate, caps and stops all still binding. A SILENT whale does NOT seat 0.0 (that would flatten the book on the 46/57/88%% of ticks where it has no opinion — P2). REVERT: set whale_seat_mode to "off".
